description: Turn a Word document (.docx or .doc, up to 25 MB) into a PDF with the layout Word gave it, on YangOpen's server. A few hundred pages take under half a minute; a much longer document may not finish. 5 free files a day, then 25 credits a file, charged only when the PDF is ready. Give the file as file_id (the user uploads it through get_upload_link) or file_url. The PDF link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the Word file there.

file_url.description: Or a public https link to a .docx or .doc file.

name: word_to_pdf
title: Convert a Word file to PDF
